title: pricing-packaging-scratchpad-alex-2026-03-04
body:
Quick back-of-envelope on token math + tier ideas — notes to self, rough.

Context / goals:
- Need simple entry tiers that: 1) look generous to developers, 2) convert to paid quickly, 3) map to unit economics for hosted API.
- Also want straightforward mapping to Dedicated commitments (reserved capacity) for enterprise.

Assumptions (rough, round numbers):
- Infra cost baseline: $2.5 / GPU-hour (amortized across infra + infra ops).
- Typical throughput per GPU for mid-size open model (quantized): ~200 tokens/sec sustained (very workload dependent).
- Effective tokens/sec per $: 200 tokens/sec * 3600 sec / $2.5 = 288k tokens per $ (if single GPU exclusively).
- But realistic utilization & infra overhead -> apply utilization factor 0.45 => ~130k tokens per $.
- So cost to us ~= $1 / 130k tokens = $0.0000077 per token (~$0.0077 per 1k tokens).
- Add infra & ops overhead + margin -> target gross cost basis for hosted: $0.00002 per token (~$0.02 per 1k).

Check with simple examples:
- 1M tokens -> cost basis ~= $20.
- Starter plan (2M tokens/mo) -> cost basis $40/mo.
- If we price Starter at $20/mo that's loss-leading, so need to decide whether Starter subsidized.

Common request sizes to think about:
- Small dev call: 50–200 tokens (prompt + short completion).
- Chat session: 500–2k tokens (multi-turn).

Pricing model primitives to mix: per-token, per-embedding, per-request (or bundled), monthly tiers, reserved capacity commitments with discounts.

Tier ideas (early brainstorm):
- Free (developer trial): 75k tokens credit + 3 months access to hosted models. Purpose: quick prototyping, lower friction.
- Starter (individual): $20/mo -> 1.5M tokens (effective price ~$0.013/1k tokens). Good for single developer prototypes. Consider limiting QPS or max sequence to avoid abuse.
- Team (early SMB): $200/mo -> 20M tokens (~$0.01/1k). Includes basic metrics and 30-day log retention. Seat-based add-on for console?
- Business (growing apps): $1,500/mo -> 200M tokens (~$0.0075/1k). Includes longer logs, SSO, priority support.
- Enterprise / Dedicated: custom pricing -> offer committed GPU-hours (e.g., 4xA100 equivalent) with volume discounts and SLAs.

Notes on embedding pricing:
- Embeddings are cheaper compute per query but often higher call volume. Back-of-envelope: embeddings cost basis ~10% of text-generation per token (depends on model).
- Suggested: price embeddings per 1k vectors (or per 100k dims), or per 1M embedding calls. Simpler: $0.003 / 1k embedding vectors for baseline models, discount tiers with volume.

Billing levers and controls:
- Rate limits (QPS) per tier to protect infra.
- Token caps per request & per minute to prevent flood.
- Soft throttles for free tier, hard for starter.
- Auto-upgrade prompts when usage >80% of monthly allotment (nudge to paid).

Mapping to Dedicated / Reserved capacity:
- Offer 20–30% discount when customers commit to X GPUs or Y tokens/month for 12 months.
- Create conversion path: estimate token equivalent per reserved GPU-hour and map to hosted credit. E.g., 1 reserved GPU-hour ~= 130k tokens (using utilization factor above).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Validate infra numbers with infra team: actual tokens/sec for our quantized stacks across model families (JIRA-PRICING-1234 assigned to @Riley).
- Decide target gross margin for hosted API (target 60%+?). Need finance input.
- How to handle expensive model variants (long-context, high-accuracy) in tiers: metered separately or billable add-on?
- Embeddings measurement: count by vectors returned vs tokens consumed? Simpler for billing to count embedding calls.
- Free tier abuse detection heuristics.

Quick UX heuristics:
- Communicate tokens in human terms: e.g., "~2M tokens = ~20k short responses or 4k chat sessions". Provide calculator in Console.
- Show estimated $ per 1k tokens per model in model picker.

Random sample calculations for marketing blurbs (rounded):
- "Starter: $20/mo for 1.5M tokens (~$0.013/1k)."
- "Team: $200/mo for 20M tokens (~$0.01/1k)."
- "Business: $1,500/mo for 200M tokens (~$0.0075/1k)."
- "Embeddings: $0.003 / 1k vectors (baseline)."

Notes to self: keep pricing simple on the surface, hide complexity behind auto-scaling & model-routing policies. Avoid too many per-model exceptions unless model materially affects cost (e.g., 8k->128k context).

Links / refs: pull tokens/sec benchmarks from infra perf docs (confluence: CONFLUENCE-PRICING-901) and ownership from @Noah for embeddings costing.

End of scratchpad — next steps: sync with infra (throughput), finance (margin target), growth (go-to-market messaging).

-- Alex
